title: Animated elements outside focal area and information-seeking performance
statement:
Continuously animated elements outside the user's primary focal area significantly degrade performance on information-seeking tasks by constantly pulling visual attention.

Options:
- Safe Initial Alert: Animate once, then static (fits: new feature tags, inbox unread badges)
- High Focus: Strictly static UI (fits: long form reading, complex forms)
- High Disruption (Use Sparingly): Continuous subtle pulsing (fits: live recording status, system outages)
appliesWhen: Applies to: content pages, dashboards, reading apps. Audience: general, seniors.

source.title: The effects of animation on information seeking performance on the World Wide Web
source.venue: Journal of the Association for Information Systems
